The '''Minyavish''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qaras]]. For seven thousand years they saw themselves as managers of the planet with native [[Jessar]] species as their servants. In [[44 ABY]], the Minyavish were revolted against by the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] Jessar. The Jessar then forced the Minyavish to leave the planet.

==Biology and appearance==
The Minyavish were roughly humanoid with short legs, round torsos, barrel chests, arms with round shoulders, and large heads. They had huge golden eyes, with slit shaped pupils, which were darker gold in color. Their pale blue skin was covered in different colored feathers including purple, green, and [[Gold/Legends|gold]]. Their blood was the color of golden honey
